author: Forrest Galante
description:
To be clear, this is not a zoo. This is a look inside Vantara's elephant sanctuary. This is a rescue and rehabilitation center dedicated to conservation. This is the first ever exclusive, behind-the-scenes private tour of the world's largest wildlife rescue and rehab center. Thank you for the honor of allowing us to film here ‪@reliancevantara‬ and thank you Anant Ambani for caring so much about these incredible animals.
